'''Korbel''' was the nickname of a [[Medic/Legends|medic]]-trained [[Clone Captain/Legends|clone trooper captain]] serving in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he and a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of his men accompanied [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] to the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Zigoola]] to [[Mission to Zigoola|rescue]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], who had been injured and stranded there during an investigation of the planet. After retrieving the two, the group returned to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During their flight, Korbel and his men treated Kenobi, and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was later able to make a full recovery.

==Biography==
{{Quote|On the night side. And they're alone. Whole vaping planet's empty, pretty much.|Korbel, on Kenobi and Organa|<ref name="Wild Space" />}}
[[File:ObiWanKenobi1-TCWLD.png|thumb|left|200px|Korbel helped to rescue Master Kenobi from Zigoola.]]
The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] nicknamed "Korbel"<ref name="Wild Space" /> was [[Cloning/Legends|cloned]] from the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to fight in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Encyclopedia: Clone troopers" /> Serving as a [[Clone Captain/Legends|clone captain]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Army/Legends|army]], Korbel was fully [[Medic/Legends|medic]]-trained.<ref name="Wild Space" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] assigned the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and several of his [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] to help [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] [[Mission to Zigoola|retrieve]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] from the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Zigoola]], where the two had been stranded during their investigation of a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-related threat to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the Republic. Because Kenobi had been severely injured on Zigoola, Master Yoda hand-picked Korbel and his men for their medical abilities to participate in rescuing the Jedi Master.<ref name="Wild Space" />

Korbel and five of his men met Amidala in her private [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], where Korbel introduced himself and his men and became acquainted with Amidala. Once the troopers had made quarters in Amidala's [[H-type Nubian yacht/Legends|H-type Nubian yacht]], the group set out for the Wild Space world in the [[Yacht/Legends|vessel]] using a pre-plotted [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] course that Yoda had provided. Arriving in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the planet, Korbel commented that the Royal Yacht was the "sweetest [[Starship/Legends|ship]] he had flown in his life" while scanning the world for Kenobi's and Organa's lifesigns, which had also been provided by Yoda. Locating the stranded pair on the planet's night side, Korbel told Amidala that, as a safety measure, he and his men would reconnoiter the area before she disembarked, to which Amidala agreed. After Korbel and the clones had completed their inspection of the vicinity, Senator Amidala joined them on the surface of the planet. Both Organa and Kenobi had been injured, and the latter's leg was badly wounded. After briefly conferring with the two, Amidala allowed Korbel and one of his men to carry the Jedi onto the yacht. On the return trip to Coruscant, Korbel treated and administered a painkiller to Kenobi. After a week of healing in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], Master Kenobi was able to make a full recovery.<ref name="Wild Space" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|We're all of us fully medic-trained, so that won't be a problem. We'll take good care of the general and Senator Organa.|Korbel, to Padmé Amidala|<ref name="Wild Space" />}}
A Human [[Gender/Legends|male]], Korbel stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="Encyclopedia: Clone troopers" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" /> Fully medic-trained, he was compassionate, even with his intense clone trooper training on Kamino. During the flight to Zigoola, he and his men kept a "professional and polite" distance from Senator Amidala and also took care of both her and themselves with efficiency. He was complimentary about the yacht's medbay and noted that the vessel was "the sweetest ship had piloted in his life." After landing on Zigoola, Korbel and his men performed a reconnaissance on the nearby area for Senator Amidala's protection. Korbel and one of his men carried Kenobi onto the yacht "with a careful tenderness" that surprised Amidala.<ref name="Wild Space" />

==Behind the scenes==
Korbel appeared in the [[2008]] novel ''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]'', written by [[Karen Miller]] as a tie-in novel for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.<ref name="Wild Space" />
